title: A finitely generated prime is associated exactly when it is weakly associated
statement: Let R be a commutative ring and M an R-module [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. Let p be a prime ideal of R that is finitely generated. Say that p is associated to M when p is the annihilator of some element of M, and weakly associated to M when p is minimal among the prime ideals containing the annihilator of some element of M. Then p is associated to M if and only if p is weakly associated to M.
